name: The Hulbert household at 2123 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_hulbert_thomas_h

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 2123 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 2123 Thomas H. Hulbert.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 2123, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. In 1900 a Gray household lived here (the head's initials are hard to read), not the Hulberts. The census says nothing about this household's staff. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Thomas H. Hulbert
persons.printed_as: 2123 Thomas H. Hubbart [1904 OCR] / Thomas H. Hulbert [1905 OCR]
persons.note: The two editions' OCR disagree on the surname, 'Hubbart' in 1904 and 'Hulbert' in 1905; the page images were not read, so the spelling is the 1905 reading and is not settled.
